topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I don’t know how to feel about it all. The thought of walking into that room, filled with smiles and balloons, all there just for me, seemed like the perfect end to a less than perfect week. Now, it’s just a lone message on my phone, a string of apologetic words that fade into the silence of my evening. I guess plans change, and it’s all part of the unpredictability of life. I’ll just have to mark the day quietly, maybe with a book or a walk, something to fill the space that was meant for laughter and surprise. It’s not the end of the world, just a little hollow, a bit quieter than I expected.
